name: don't let him in 🏠 [NEW]
desc:
⭐ New Update Soon ⭐
Bugs can happen, write them to the group wall

When night approaches the crazy burglar looks for houses to break in. You are his target. BUT...
You forgot your hard earned Dominus in another room! Oh no, The burglar heard you talk about it and now a traumatizing night will pursue.
Watch the tutorial to know how to SURVIVE...

Your main goal is to NOT let him in, protect the Dominus at ALL COST and survive until 8 am to win
This game is so much easier and funnier with friends and strategy! (Multiplayer Supported)

[ TIPS ]
Turn up your Volume for the best Experience (Audio Cues)
When the Robber is at a window quickly flash your flashlight MULTIPLE times to scare him away
Fix the Power when its down, to be able to see around and for the TIME to progress

[ CONTROLS ]
L2/Shift or Mobile Shift Button to Sprint
